controls: Cooldowns and HP reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the item/order under test
Same enemy hero, level, items, behaviour
Run every arm at each condition (1, 2, 3 targets in the cluster)
title: Wraith sustain: Leech vs Vampiric Burst with Ricochet
question: When Wraith shoots three targets with Ricochet bouncing, does Leech or Vampiric Burst give more sustain over a real fight window?
hypothesis: Vampiric Burst gives more burst sustain per use (30s cooldown) but Leech gives more over a 30s window with sustained AoE bounces; the answer depends on target count.

arms.name: leech
arms.souls: same spend; Vampiric Burst slot replaced with equal-cost filler

arms.name: vampiric_burst
arms.notes: no Leech; use Vampiric Burst on cooldown

enemies.behaviour: stand in cluster within 12m, fire back

procedure: Shoot the cluster with normal ability rotation for 30s
Use Vampiric Burst on cooldown in its arm only

decision.rule: run at targets=1,2,3 and report the crossover
